Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full-time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is seeking a Lead Business Analyst to serve as the senior BA lead on a federal environmental data integration program. In this role, you will bring expertise in Endangered Species Act - Section 7 consultation processes and federal environmental platform workflows to drive requirements, compliance validation, and cross-agency coordination at the highest level.

Work Location: Remote

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the senior business analysis lead across the full project, providing SME-level expertise in Endangered Species Act - Section 7 consultation processes, platform workflows, and multi-agency coordination
  • Lead requirements elicitation and documentation for all platform changes including species display, decision logic updates, template updates, and consultation routing
  • Conduct gap analysis between current platform capabilities and integration requirements, documenting findings for technical deliverables
  • Facilitate joint requirements workshops with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) Ecological Services and NOAA Fisheries SMEs
  • Lead the development of consultation logic alignment documentation for joint agency use
  • Support compliance validation by verifying that species list generation, decision logic, template content, and consultation routing meet regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with government SMEs to obtain required approvals and sign-offs on compliance-critical deliverables
  • Lead pilot consultation workflow design, defining scenarios covering all consultation types
  • Analyze pilot results and live consultation feedback, translating findings into actionable system updates
  • Lead the development of the Pilot Report with Metrics, capturing consultation cycle times, completion rates, defect summaries, and actionable findings from pilot workflow execution
  • Lead the development of the Endangered Species Act - Section 7 Compliance Validation Checklist, documenting validation criteria for species list generation accuracy, decision logic correctness, template content completeness, and consultation routing
  • Coordinate government review and acceptance of Updated DKeys and Consultation Package Builder Assets, ensuring all content meets regulatory requirements and agency sign-off is obtained
  • Contribute to final operational documentation and year-end reporting

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 16 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Extensive years of business analysis experience on federal IT programs
  • Expertise in Endangered Species Act - Section 7 consultation processes
  • Experience with federal environmental regulatory systems and multi-agency coordination

  • Experience facilitating OMB or executive-level government reviews and demonstration preparation

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

jobs.description:
About us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role:

Nourish is looking for talented Senior Backend Engineers to join our fast-growing team! As a key, early member of Nourish’s engineering team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our core platform. Working side-by-side with engineering, product, design, and analytics, you’ll drive the development of critical features that will lay the foundation for years to come.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager of your Pod, you’ll take full ownership of major parts of the codebase, setting ambitious timelines and leading project deliverables. Whether you’re in the Ops or Platform Pod, your contributions will be essential in bringing our product roadmap to life and building scalable technology to transform interactions with patients, dietitians, and insurance companies.

This role is full-time and open to remote or onsite/hybrid out of Nourish’s NYC office in the heart of Union Square. Check out ‘Engineering at Nourish’ to learn more about our team and what we’ve already built!

Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and ship cutting-edge products and features at lightning speed without compromising on quality.
  • Drive continuous improvements in our engineering processes, tools, and systems to scale both our codebase and team productivity.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across product, design, engineering, and analytics to solve challenging and impactful problems in a data-driven experimentation culture.
  • Contribute to the estimations, planning and execution of projects, features, and integrations.
  • Maintain and elevate our existing codebase by developing, releasing, and maintaining backend services and/or infrastructure.
  • Write clean, fully-tested, high-performance code that sets the standard for excellence.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years as a Backend focused Software Engineer, preferably building high-performance internal platforms to streamline internal business operations, developer experience, or devops.
  • 3+ years utilizing our tech stack (Typescript, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, AWS) or confidence and excitement about cross-training and up-skilling!
  • Do your own stunts and ship fast. You like to build and ship new things, can independently take a project from idea through implementation, and run toward hard problems.
  • Think work should feel like play. You value a very collaborative, close-knit team and care about having fun and making an impact at work.
  • Want to be deeply involved in product and design. You are not only passionate about engineering but also have a desire to build a product end-to-end, through the design, coding, testing, and deployment phases. We're an early-stage startup where product, design, and engineering are closely intertwined.
  • Think from first principles. Ask why, challenge assumptions, and value the right answer over being right.
  • Nice to Have’s
    • Startup or Scale Up experience. You have that dog in you; you’re resilient and persevere through challenges.
    • Interviewing Experience. We’re quickly growing our Engineering function and expect our Engineers to help us do so!
    • Energized by our mission. Our mission defines everything we do, we need engineers hungry to improve people’s health by making it easy to eat well.

Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking an experienced Software Product Management Lead to drive the vision, strategy, modernization, and delivery of the Military OneSource public-facing website and its WordPress-based digital experience under the MODES III program. This leader will translate the needs of Service Members, military families, government stakeholders, content teams, and program partners into secure, accessible, user-centered product capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines strong Agile product leadership with practical knowledge of WordPress, web content platforms, custom software development, cloud-native services, low-code/no-code solutions, and responsible use of AI-assisted and AI-generated applications.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, outcomes, and roadmap for the Military OneSource website and supporting digital services.
  • Align product priorities with mission objectives, customer needs, contract requirements, technical feasibility, security, accessibility, and available resources.
  • Establish measurable product goals and use analytics, user feedback, service data, and operational insights to guide investment and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder and User Leadership

  • Collaborate with government product owners, program leadership, communications and content teams, users, business analysts, UX designers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, developers, testers, and operations teams.
  • Translate mission needs and policy objectives into product requirements, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release objectives.
  • Facilitate product discovery, roadmap reviews, demonstrations, governance discussions, and executive-level decision briefings.
  • Champion human-centered design and the needs of military Service Members and families across the product lifecycle.

WordPress and Digital Experience Leadership

  • Lead modernization, sustainment, and enhancement of a large-scale WordPress website, including content publishing, search, forms, integrations, themes, plugins, and reusable components.
  • Guide decisions involving WordPress core capabilities, Gutenberg/block editing, custom themes and plugins, headless or decoupled patterns, content APIs, and integration with enterprise services.
  • Partner with content owners to improve information architecture, content governance, findability, usability, performance, and publishing workflows.
  • Ensure digital experiences are responsive, reliable, accessible, and consistent across devices and browsers.

Agile Product Delivery and Release Management

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog and ensure work is ready for planning, refinement, development, testing, release, and acceptance.
  • Lead product planning, sprint and increment objectives, release sequencing, dependency management, risk resolution, and stakeholder communications.
  • Balance new features, modernization, technical debt, defect remediation, cybersecurity findings, content needs, and operational support.
  • Validate delivered capabilities against acceptance criteria and mission outcomes, and coordinate user acceptance activities with government stakeholders.

Technology Modernization and Innovation

  • Guide cross-functional teams delivering solutions using PHP, Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, and related modern web technologies.
  • Evaluate when to use WordPress configuration, custom development, low-code/no-code platforms, AI-assisted or AI-generated applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native services.
  • Promote modular, maintainable, API-enabled solutions that reduce vendor lock-in and support future technology transitions.
  • Coordinate with architects and engineering leads on cloud hosting, containers, serverless services, managed databases, content delivery, observability, resilience, and integration patterns.

Cybersecurity, Accessibility, Quality, and Operations

  • Integrate secure software development, privacy, records management, Section 508 accessibility, performance, availability, and operational support into product decisions and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate product priorities supporting RMF, NIST SP 800-53 controls, Zero Trust principles, vulnerability remediation, privacy requirements, and Authority to Operate activities.
  • Apply ITIL practices to incident, problem, change, release, service request, and continual improvement activities affecting the product.
  • Ensure documentation, training, knowledge transfer, release notes, and operational readiness are completed for product changes.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

  • Must hold an active Secret clearance supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

Education (Required)

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Product Management, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered when permitted by contract requirements.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in software product management, product ownership, digital product delivery, or technology leadership.
  • Experience leading product vision, roadmaps, feature strategies, backlogs, releases, and user-focused requirements for enterprise web applications or digital services.
  • Demonstrated experience leading Agile, cross-functional product teams in complex federal, DoD, public-sector, healthcare, human services, or similarly regulated environments.
  • Experience managing or modernizing public-facing websites, content management systems, or high-volume digital service platforms.
  • Experience collaborating with government stakeholders and translating mission and policy needs into actionable software outcomes.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong functional and technical understanding of WordPress, including content management, themes, plugins, Gutenberg/block editing, integrations, APIs, publishing workflows, and platform sustainment.
  • Working knowledge of PHP, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SQL, RESTful APIs, and relational databases such as MySQL or MariaDB.
  • Working knowledge of Python and Java, including how these technologies may support integrations, automation, data processing, services, and custom applications adjacent to WordPress.
  • Experience working with low-code/no-code application development platforms; experience with OutSystems, Microsoft Power Platform, Appian, Mendix, or similar platforms is desirable.
  • Understanding of AI-assisted development and AI-generated applications, including product governance, human review, data protection, testing, security, accessibility, and lifecycle considerations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native services and architectures, including APIs, microservices, containers, serverless computing, managed databases, content delivery networks, observability, and CI/CD.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management, sprint planning, release management, and end-to-end software development lifecycles.
  • Understanding of secure software design, DevSecOps, federal cybersecurity expectations, privacy, and Section 508 accessibility.

jobs.title: Freelance Agent Evaluation Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST Sunday September 13th, 2026

Intro to Position

We are seeking a data-driven and highly creative marketing strategist to grow our audience for NPR’s owned platforms, with a focus on The NPR app. You will act as a guiding force behind NPR’s mobile growth, leveraging data and insights to inform strategies and tactics that migrate audiences to the core digital experience that will define NPR for years to come.

You will manage a dedicated advertising budget, and will also be expected to make the most of NPR’s own channels like our podcasts, broadcast, website, and of course the NPR app’s messaging and UX. You will work closely with the app and web product teams, the audience insights and analytics teams, the content teams and the Network growth teams, and many others while you seek to find loyal users, keep them engaged, and transform this platform into an indispensable daily habit that sustains our journalism and mission.

You will lead test-and-learn campaigns, making data-informed decisions on where we should invest our resources next. Your goal is to understand our audience’s needs, deepen their engagement with our content, and identify exactly where NPR’s app stands out in a crowded landscape, ultimately shaping how public media thrives in a mobile-first world.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

  • Execute Marketing Campaigns: Plan the strategy and messaging for campaigns that give people a clear, compelling reason to download and use the NPR app, translating our trusted journalism into a dynamic, modern mobile experience.
  • Manage Paid and Free/Owned Media: Run ads across social media, search, and video platforms, while also creating promotions for NPR's own radio broadcasts, podcasts, and newsletters to ensure our public service journalism reaches audiences wherever they are.
  • Manage the Budget: Decide how to spend our advertising money effectively to get the best return on investment and the lowest cost per download, helping build a sustainable, digital-first growth engine for the network.
  • Lead Across Teams: Bring together people from the product, analytics, content, and broadcast teams in order to execute campaigns that feel cohesive and true to NPR.
  • Keep Users Coming Back: Build plans (using tools like push notifications, in-app-messages, and emails) to turn first-time downloaders into dedicated returning users, elevating our listeners’ daily routines by making the app an indispensable companion.
  • Understand Our Audience: Research the app landscape to see trends, what others are doing right, figure out where NPR stands out, and make sure our marketing speaks directly to what our audience needs.
  • Test and Improve: Always approach projects with a testing mindset and determine what strategies drive new installs and deeper engagement.
  • Track Success: Track conversions in actionable ways that can help drive near and long-term marketing decisions. You will work closely with our Audience Insights and Product teams to track all your promotional strategies, but especially digital ads and even terrestrial radio promo.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a data-driven marketing role, preferably at a media or tech company

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to thoughtfully establish new cross-team processes, strategies, and tools for collaboration if/when a marketing plan requires something we have never executed before.
  • An execution-focused collaborator who thoughtfully balances team input while maintaining a strong bias for action. You know when to align, but also when to roll up your sleeves and keep things moving.
  • Ability to turn complex numbers into clear, simple stories that inform leadership decisions.
  • A talent for competitive analysis and a deep curiosity about audience behavior.

The Financial ERP Oracle Functional Solutions Architect is the functional architecture authority for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB), with responsibility for solution strategy, functional design, platform governance, release and upgrade planning, integration oversight, and long-term application health. The Architect translates complex finance, billing, revenue management, reporting, control, and operational requirements into scalable and supportable Oracle solutions. This position works directly with Finance, business process owners, product owners, Enterprise Architecture, Data Services, application support teams, internal IT teams, Oracle, and third-party partners to improve business outcomes, maximize delivered Oracle capabilities, and reduce unnecessary customization.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Own and maintain the functional solution architecture and roadmap for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and ORMB.
  • Lead discovery, requirements analysis, fit-gap assessment, future-state process design, solution option evaluation, and functional design decisions.

  • Prioritize delivered Oracle capabilities and recommend extensions or customization only when justified by business value, risk, and supportability.

  • Assess Oracle update and release impacts and provide direction for configuration review, business readiness, regression testing, and adoption of applicable capabilities.
  • Provide functional architecture leadership across ORMB customer and account structures, pricing, billing, receivables, payments, adjustments, collections, delinquency, financial interfaces, and related revenue-management functions.
  • Lead ORMB fit-gap analysis and recommend product-based, configurable, and supportable approaches.
  • Apply working knowledge of ORMB architecture and the Oracle Utilities Application Framework to evaluate functional options, dependencies, upgrade impacts, and approved extensions.
  • Partner with business owners and technical teams on the functional behavior of ORMB integrations, conversions, reports, invoice outputs, batch processing, and exception handling.
  • Provide functional oversight for integrations connecting Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and ORMB with Oracle Integration Cloud, enterprise data platforms, financial institutions, reporting solutions, and approved upstream and downstream systems.
  • Define and validate functional requirements for inbound and outbound interfaces, APIs, files, batch processes, sequencing, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and recovery.
  • Ensure financial, billing, operational, and reconciliation reporting requirements are included in end-to-end solution designs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required.

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefit management, insurance, financial services, utilities, or another complex billing environment preferred.

  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy, security, audit, and regulatory requirements preferred.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Remote | Pediatrics | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $5-$6/hour

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and adaptable Virtual Medical Assistant to support a growing pediatric practice during its pre-opening and early growth stages.

This is not a traditional, narrowly defined Medical VA position. During the startup phase, you will work closely with the physician as an administrative and personal assistant, helping coordinate meetings, calendars, vendors, projects, communications, and clinic setup activities.

As the practice begins seeing patients, your responsibilities will gradually transition toward front-office and medical administrative support, including scheduling, patient intake, insurance verification, and patient communication.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a growing environment where priorities can change, takes ownership without needing constant reminders, and can independently identify what needs to be done next.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive, Administrative & Calendar Support

  • Manage and organize the physician's calendars, ensuring meetings, deadlines, agendas, links, documents, and preparation materials are consolidated in one place.

  • Attend administrative and vendor meetings as needed, take clear notes, document action items, and help ensure important follow-ups are completed.

  • Serve as a proactive accountability partner by tracking deadlines, projects, tasks, and outstanding items without requiring constant reminders.

2. Front Office & Patient Communication

  • Manage incoming patient calls, emails, texts, voicemails, and initial inquiries professionally once the clinic begins accepting patients.

  • Assist prospective and existing families with scheduling, follow-ups, basic questions, and other front-office communication needs.

  • Provide a warm, professional first point of contact that reflects the patient-centered experience expected from a pediatric practice.

3. Patient Scheduling, Intake & Registration

  • Coordinate end-to-end patient scheduling, including new patient appointments, follow-ups, rescheduling, and appointment-related communication.

  • Support patient intake and check-in by ensuring required demographic, administrative, and insurance information is collected accurately.

  • Maintain organized patient information and appointment records within eClinicalWorks (eCW) while following established clinic workflows.

4. Insurance Verification & Administrative Support

  • Verify commercial insurance coverage and determine whether patient insurance plans are active, pending, or require additional follow-up.

  • Complete insurance eligibility and benefit verification before appointments and document findings accurately for the practice.

  • Assist with insurance-related administrative tasks and potentially prior authorizations as clinic processes expand.

5. Vendor, Research & Project Coordination

  • Research vendors, clinic equipment, software, and other operational needs and compare available options based on cost, features, and suitability.

  • Organize research findings, pricing comparisons, project updates, and recommendations using spreadsheets and other tracking tools.

  • Follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders to keep clinic setup projects progressing according to established timelines.

6. Process Documentation & SOP Development

  • Document recurring workflows and administrative processes as the clinic develops its operating procedures.

  • Create clear step-by-step SOPs for tasks such as scheduling, patient communication, insurance verification, and other recurring activities.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to organize, standardize, and improve workflows as the practice grows.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is REQUIRED. Candidates without prior eCW experience should not be considered.

  • 1+ years previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Assistant, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong administrative, organizational, calendar-management, and task-management skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English with the confidence to communicate professionally with patients, families, vendors, and healthcare professionals.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to organize information, research, projects, and workflows independently.

  • Highly proactive and able to recognize what needs attention without waiting to be reminded.

  • Comfortable working in a startup-style environment where responsibilities and priorities may evolve.

  • Able to multitask effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable using required secure networks, clinic systems, and productivity tracking software.

Strongly Preferred

  • Previous experience working in pediatrics.

  • Experience performing commercial insurance verification.

  • Experience handling prior authorizations for commercial insurance or HMO plans.

  • Experience supporting a physician, clinic owner, executive, or small medical practice.

  • Basic Canva or graphic-editing skills for simple social media or clinic content.

Tools & Systems

Candidates may work with:

  • eClinicalWorks (eCW) EMR, REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • RingRX or similar HIPAA-compliant phone systems

  • Google Calendar or other multi-calendar systems

  • Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet tools

  • Canva

  • Secure private networks/VPNs

  • Productivity tracking software

What Success Looks Like

You will succeed in this role if you become someone the physician can trust to take ownership of responsibilities, anticipate what needs to happen next, and keep important tasks from falling through the cracks.

You should be able to work independently, organize competing priorities, communicate professionally with families, and help create systems that allow the physician to focus more heavily on patient care.

As the practice grows, success will also mean helping create a smooth patient experience from the first phone call through scheduling, intake, insurance verification, and ongoing follow-up.

We are industry leaders in video security and analytics, with solutions deployed in more than 120 countries across diverse environments such as school campuses, transportation systems, healthcare centers, public venues, critical infrastructure, prisons, factories, casinos, airports, financial institutions, government facilities, and retailers. Our AI-powered security solutions integrate advanced video analytics, machine learning, and embedded intelligence to enable proactive threat detection, enhanced situational awareness, and automated decision-making.


Job Description

The Director of Computer Vision will drive the technical vision, research and engineering execution for the platform, with focus on the following core areas:

  • Foundational Research Strategy:Define the long-term research agenda for fundamental computer vision capabilities and drive the culture of scientific excellence.

  • Technical Vision, Engineering Leadership, and Execution:Provide executive technical leadership to a unified research and engineering organization, defining the technical architecture, strategy, and engineering roadmap for the Computer Vision Platform. Drive execution, ensuring the seamless translation of product requirements into robust technical specifications and successful delivery of next-generation visual intelligence solutions that are highly scalable and align with overall product and business strategy.

  • Organizational Leadership and Talent Strategy:Manage and scale a unified computer vision research and engineering organization distributed across multiple geographies, overseeing multiple teams, and defining the strategy for recruiting, mentoring, and attracting world-class talent.

  • End-to-End MLOps and Deployment:Own the entire engineering lifecycle for central, reusable computer vision models and foundational AI infrastructure. This includes establishing best-in-class MLOps practices for scalable training, efficient deployment, continuous monitoring, and performance optimization across edge and cloud environments.

  • Performance Measurement and Continuous Improvement:Define, implement, and track key technical performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, model efficiency, system reliability) to measure engineering success, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement in execution and delivery.

  • Technical Innovation and Risk Management: Evaluate and integrate cutting-edge computer vision research and technologies. Proactively identify and mitigate significant technical risks, and lead critical engineering decisions, including build-versus-buy analysis.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of technical leadership experience leading computer vision teams and organizations, with a focus on building and deploying enterprise-scale platforms and solutions in production.

  • Technical Acumen & Deep Expertise:Deep, demonstrable expertise in computer vision, machine learning algorithms, and the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle, including 5+ years of hands-on experience building and optimizing computer vision models or as a computer vision researcher. Proven ability to engage in complex technical discussions, define the architectural vision for central, reusable AI infrastructure and models, and drive technical strategy while managing critical trade-offs.

  • Executive Technical Strategy & Metrics: Proven experience defining long-term technical vision, engineering strategy, and roadmaps for a large-scale platform. Expertise in defining and implementing technical metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, system reliability, model efficiency) to measure engineering excellence and drive continuous improvement across an organization.

  • Organizational & People Leadership:Demonstrated ability to manage and scale a unified, distributed engineering and research organization of 50 to 100 people, mentor senior technical talent, and lead multiple teams across different geographies.

  • Strong Analytical and Research Skills:Hands-on experience driving innovation through foundational research, working with AI performance metrics (e.g., Precision/Recall), real-time video processing, and inference optimization.

  • Customer-Driven Technical Leadership (Pathfinding):Track record of translating highly ambiguous product concepts and complex customer needs into clear, executable technical roadmaps and architectural specifications.

  • Start-up Mentality & Agility:Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment is highly valued, demonstrating high ownership, bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to drive 0-to-1 product development with limited resources.

  • Domain Knowledge:Experience in public safety, security-focused software (e.g., video security, evidence management), mission-critical systems, or emergency communications is a plus.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description:Business Development Manager - Hellenic Systems LtdLocation: Home-based, anywhere in the UK, with regular travel to customer sites and periodic visits to our Essex head office About Hellenic SystemsFounded in 1988, Hellenic Systems Ltd builds the systems that run the factory floor.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Business Development Manager - Hellenic Systems Ltd

Location: Home-based, anywhere in the UK, with regular travel to customer sites and periodic visits to our Essex head office

About Hellenic Systems

Founded in 1988, Hellenic Systems Ltd builds the systems that run the factory floor. Our software tells operators what to make and in what order, records what actually happened, and proves it to an auditor afterwards. The industry name for this is Manufacturing Execution Systems, or MES: the layer that sits between a company’s business systems and the machinery and people producing the goods. We design and manufacture the hardware that goes with it as well.

We are UK-based and serve over 130 sites across the UK and Europe. Our roots are in food manufacturing, particularly meat and poultry, and we are now extending into any manufacturer with the same problem to solve. A large share of what we ship is built specifically for one customer, which is why our tagline, Built Around You, is meant literally.

Our three software products are CARCASE, our kill line and livestock system, FOPS, our Factory Order Processing System, and FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system. Our hardware includes weigh scales, touch screen terminals, outer case marking systems, carcass data capture units and label printers.

Since 2023 we have been part of Vesta Software Group, which sits within Jonas Software, an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. Constellation is one of the largest acquirers of vertical market software businesses in the world.

We are also unusually far along with AI for a business our size. It is embedded in how we build software and how we work day to day, not run as a side project, and we expect everyone here to use it.

The Opportunity

FORMIX, our recipe and formulation management system, has been rebuilt as a new product and is our main new business push. It guides operators through ingredient weigh-up, enforces tolerances, captures batch and operator evidence, and connects to shop floor weighing and labelling hardware. The buyers are food and drink manufacturers who still run weigh-up on paper, spreadsheets or an awkward ERP screen, and who are under real pressure on allergen control, traceability and waste.

This is a new role. It exists to build and convert a new business pipeline that does not depend on our existing account base.

Job Summary

The Business Development Manager owns new business at Hellenic. The role is targeted on winning new named clients and new sites, starting with FORMIX and broadening into our wider software and hardware portfolio as the pipeline develops. It is a hunting role: self-generated prospecting, campaigns and networking, then running the opportunity through demonstration, proposal, negotiation and close, with support from our technical and commercial teams.

The BDM reports to the Head of Commercial and works alongside our Account Managers, who own existing customer relationships. Growth inside existing accounts stays with them. Anything genuinely new belongs to the BDM.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Business Generation

  • Win new named clients and new sites, principally for FORMIX in year one, broadening into CARCASE, FOPS, hardware and bespoke development as the pipeline matures.

  • Generate the majority of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns, trade events and industry networking. Marketing and referral leads will supplement this, not replace it.

  • Work the named FORMIX prospect list and the wider addressable market, including manufacturers outside our traditional meat and poultry base, such as bakery, dairy, ready meals, sauces, seasonings, flavourings and beverages.

  • Open the first opportunities in adjacent sectors as we extend the product into adjacent sectors, and feed what you learn back into product and pricing.

  • Qualify hard and early. We would rather have a smaller pipeline we believe in than a large one we do not.

2. Selling and Closing

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, on-site assessment, demonstration (in person and remote), proposal, commercial negotiation and close.

  • Build the business case in the customer’s language: reduced giveaway and waste, right first time batches, allergen control, audit-ready evidence and labour saved on the weigh-up line.

  • Prepare and present quotations and proposals that reflect our pricing model, including site-level and tiered packaging.

  • Present our solution accurately and never oversell what the product does. Where a requirement needs bespoke development, involve the technical team for scope.

  • Hand over cleanly to Projects and Support at the point of sale, including a written summary of what has been sold and what the customer expects.

3. Market, Product and Competitor Knowledge

  • Build and hold working knowledge of the FORMIX proposition and enough of the wider portfolio to spot an opportunity when a customer describes a problem.

  • Know the competition. Be able to explain where we win and where we do not.

  • Gather field intelligence on competitor pricing, bundling and contract terms.

  • Track sector trends, regulation and retailer or certification pressures (for example BRCGS) that create a reason for customers to act.

4. Pipeline, CRM and Reporting

  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline of sufficient size and quality to deliver the agreed targets, with realistic close dates and values.

  • Keep CRM current and accurate. Every opportunity, activity, contact and next step is logged.

  • Report weekly on activity, pipeline movement and forecast, and present your numbers at commercial reviews.

  • Learn and follow the company sales guidelines and standard operating procedures, and help improve our proposal and correspondence templates as you go.

  • Use AI tools in your daily workflow: prospect and account research, first-draft proposals and follow-ups, call preparation and pipeline analysis. We will give you the tools and the training.

5. Working With the Team

  • Work with the Account Managers so that new business and account growth do not collide, and pass leads to them where an opportunity sits inside an existing relationship.

  • Work with Development, Projects and Support on solution scoping, demonstrations and delivery expectations.

  • Contribute to campaigns, marketing content, case studies and event planning.

  • Attend training to keep product, sector and sales skills current, and take part in team meetings and reviews.

  • Carry out other reasonable duties related to the promotion, sale and delivery of our products as directed by the management team.

Targets and Measures of Success

You will carry a personal new business target, set annually with the Head of Commercial and reviewed each quarter. It covers new order value, new recurring revenue and a minimum number of genuinely new clients, and it is supported by activity and pipeline coverage measures and by the quality of what you put into the CRM.

The targets are built from our FORMIX commercial plan and are deliberately achievable for someone who prospects properly. We will share the detail, including the numbers and how the commission scheme works against them, at the interview stage.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential

  • Proven track record of winning new business in a B2B environment, carrying and hitting a personal new business target.

  • Experience selling a considered purchase with a multi-month sales cycle and more than one decision maker, typically operations, quality, engineering, IT and finance.

  • Comfortable self-generating pipeline.

  • Able to hold a credible conversation on a factory floor and translate an operational problem into a commercial proposal.

  • Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including the ability to write a proposal that stands on its own.

  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with the discipline to protect margin.

  • Confident with CRM discipline and accurate forecasting.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your working day. You do not need to be technical, but you do need to be someone who reaches for them rather than avoids them.

  • Full UK driving licence, and willing to travel across the UK, including overnight stays. Most of our target market sits in a band from the Midlands up through Yorkshire and the Humber into the North West, so a home base within reach of that corridor is an advantage, though we will consider strong candidates anywhere in the UK.

Desirable

  • Experience selling into food and drink manufacturing, or into another regulated manufacturing sector.

  • Familiarity with MES, ERP, traceability, weighing or labelling systems, or with production and quality processes in a manufacturing plant.

  • Experience selling a combined hardware, software and services solution rather than software alone.

  • Experience opening a new market or launching a new product into an existing customer base.

  • A strong existing network of contacts in food and drink manufacturing, at operations, quality, engineering or director level. If you can open doors on day one, tell us.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in a sales role, for research, drafting, call preparation or pipeline analysis.

Business Unit:

Hellenic Systems Limited

Career Site:

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Description

Our Regulatory Affairs Specialist II primary responsibilities include managing and planning regulatory affairs compliance for industry sponsors and/or sites in networks. This position will work closely with the regulatory affairs management, department director and/or primary investigators to ensure compliance, preparing for auditing activities while meeting strict deadlines. The Regulatory Affairs Specialist I will maintain a full study workload with minimal supervision.

This position is a US-based remote position; relocation assistance and work sponsorship are not available.

Duties include and are not limited to:

  • Establishes and maintains a document management system for regulatory electronic files

  • Maintains FDA and GCP required regulatory documentation for individual sites, studies, sponsors and/or other networks. Ensures all regulatory documentation is compliant with local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for format and content

  • Maintains critical documentation ensuring compliance

  • Modifies and/or develops informed consent forms and updates and manages protocol, investigator drug brochure and consent form modifications or amendments in compliance with IRB policy and HIPAA. This includes time sensitive correspondence with sponsors and other stakeholders.

  • Organizes and processes documentation for IRB submission for multiple trials

  • Processing of Protocol Deviations that meet the IRB reportable criteria

  • Submits urgent safety notifications to the IRB

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications for success include:

  • Associate's Degree or higher is preferred, high school graduation diploma required - qualified experience may be substituted for education

  • 3+ years' regulatory affairs work experience in a clinical research, pharmaceutical, site management organization highly desired

  • Knowledge of medical terminology, FDA, other regulatory processes highly preferred

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About PackageXPackageX is building the Physical Logistics Execution Platform for enterprise teams operating across manufacturing sites, distribution centers, warehouses, retail locations, and logistics-heavy environments.
jobs.description:
About PackageX

PackageX is building the Physical Logistics Execution Platform for enterprise teams operating across manufacturing sites, distribution centers, warehouses, retail locations, and logistics-heavy environments.

Our platform uses Vision AI, workflow automation, mobile execution, and integrations to help companies digitize, execute, and verify physical operations at the point of work, creating trusted evidence of what happened across their operations.

Our operating model is simple: Execution. Verification. Evidence.

Role Overview

PackageX is extending its platform from perception into action. Our systems identify, classify and verify what is happening on a warehouse floor. We are now closing the loop, taking that output and driving the physical equipment that acts on it.

We are hiring a Senior Robotics Solutions Engineer to lead that work in the field. You are the person who walks into an enterprise distribution center, understands their automation cell in depth, designs the integration between their robotics and our platform, and then builds it.

This is a senior, customer facing engineering role. You will spend real time on customer floors alongside distribution directors, industrial engineers and IT leadership, trusted to represent PackageX technically without supervision. Between site visits, you build.

We are starting with palletizing and pallet sorting applications in high volume distribution, and expanding from there into case and tote auditing, pick and pack validation, and material handling equipment

Contract Details

Term: Three months

Location: Remote, United States.

Reports to: Chief Technology & AI Officer.

What you will own

Field discovery: Lead technical discovery onsite. Establish the equipment and controls baseline for a cell: robot model, controller and firmware, I/O map, safety architecture, camera and sensor inventory, cycle times, throughput and physical envelope constraints. A great deal of what you need will not be written down anywhere. You get it by knowing what to ask, and who to ask.

Robot control and motion: Design, build and commission control and motion logic for industrial palletizing and sortation cells. Motion sequencing, pick and place, stacking and pallet pattern logic, singulation, and recovery from partial or failed cycles. This includes taking ownership of systems already installed and running.

Safety: Own the functional safety story end to end. Risk assessment, safeguarding, emergency stop and interlock integrity, safe speed and separation, and the documentation a customer engineering and EHS team will sign. Nothing we ship moves a machine without this.

The control interface layer: Command and telemetry between PackageX and robot controllers, PLCs, fleet managers, conveyor and sortation control. Expect ROS 2, vendor SDKs and controller APIs, HTTPS and REST, MQTT, OPC UA, and industrial fieldbus where it turns up.:

Vision to motion: Turn classification and inspection output from our vision models into safe, correct and timely machine action, including what happens when the model is uncertain and what happens when it is simply wrong.

Failure modes: Dropped links, partial task completion, and reported state that disagrees with physical reality. You design for the floor at 3am, not for the demo.

The operator surface: Enough front end capability to stand up the views that show robot driven work in progress and put exceptions in front of a human, without waiting on a designer.

Handoff and enableent: Documentation, test coverage and internal training, so the work you deliver becomes durable PackageX capability rather than a one off.

Ideal Background

Robotics and Control Depth

▪ Production experience programming and commissioning industrial robotic arms. Yaskawa Motoman, Fanuc, ABB, KUKA or Universal Robots. Coursework and hobby platforms do not count here.

▪ Fluency in robot motion. Kinematics, frames and tool center points, path planning, singularities, payload and reach limits, collision avoidance, and pattern logic for palletizing and depalletizing.

▪ You have used a teach pendant in anger, and you know exactly why a pendant program and a cell actual behaviour drift apart over years of production.

▪ Real functional safety knowledge. ISO 10218 and ISO TS 15066 where collaborative operation applies, risk assessment methodology, safety rated monitored stop, category and performance level reasoning, and safety PLCs. You can explain to a plant engineer why your design is safe, and stay standing under cross examination.

▪ Controls integration experience. PLCs, industrial protocols, sensors, conveyors, sortation, and the electrical realities of a working cell.

▪ ROS or ROS 2 in production. Equally useful: you know when ROS is the wrong answer for an industrial cell, and you say so.

Systems and Software

▪ Strong Python and C++ on the robot side.

▪ Production services in TypeScript, Node, Go or Python, and fluency with event driven integration. REST, gRPC, MQTT, WebSockets.

▪ Able to stand up a functional operator UI in React or similar without a designer holding your hand.

▪ Comfortable working next to computer vision systems. You do not need to train models. You do need to reason about latency, confidence thresholds, false positives, and what a vision system uncertainty means for a machine that is about to move.

The Field Lens

▪ You are genuinely good in a room. You can talk to a distribution director about throughput and cost, then walk twenty feet and talk to a maintenance technician about why the gripper drops every fortieth pallet. Both of them should want to talk to you again.

▪ You interview well. You ask the question behind the question, you notice when an answer is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact, and you keep pulling until you have the real constraint. Undocumented systems give up their secrets to people who are patient and specific.

▪ You have delivered onsite for enterprise customers and you understand what it costs them to have you on their floor. You work around their shift patterns, not the other way around.

▪ You write things down in a way that another engineer, and a customer executive, can act on.

▪ You can tell your own leadership that a scope is not achievable in the timeline. Early, with evidence, before it becomes a crisis.

The Product Lens

▪ You think about the second customer while building for the first. Which parts of this belong in the PackageX platform as reusable robotics capability, and which parts are honestly bespoke to one cell.

▪ You can hold a commercial constraint in your head while making a technical choice, and explain the trade to someone who is not an engineer.

▪ You have opinions about what we should not build.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking talented Deep Learning Scientists / AI Researchers / Machine Learning Engineers to join our rapidly growing AI Safety and Responsibility efforts for Enterprise Risk Management. In this role, you will take on innovative problems in machine learning, focusing specifically on scaling safety for multi-modal Large Language Models (LLMs) including advanced agentic safety.

NVIDIA is in a unique position: we develop AI-based products across multiple domains and collaborate with the world’s leading AI companies as partners and customers. This role is directed at measuring improving the security, content safety, and inclusivity of our frontier models. Because we are expanding across multiple pillars of safety, we are looking for specialists with deep expertise in one or more of the following core focus areas:

  • LLM Security: Focus on backdoors, data poisoning, latent malicious behavior, and structural model vulnerabilities.

  • Frontier Risks: Focus on advanced alignment challenges, including model deception, manipulation, and loss-of-control scenarios.

  • Agentic Safety: Focus on LLM-level safety for autonomous systems, including multi-turn tool-calling, orchestration, and execution risks.

  • Multi-turn Safety Evaluation: Focus on robust, scalable automated evaluation methodologies for conversational and iterative multi-turn use cases.

What you'll be doing:

  • Evaluation:Develop datasets and specialized models & algorithms to evaluate/benchmark models & end-to-end systems in our core safety tracks (LLM Security, Agentic Safety, Content Safety, Hallucinations, and ML Fairness).

  • Model Pre-Training, Mid-Training, Post-Training:Develop datasets and recipes for filtering training data, developing training datasets & recipes, including components like RL environments and teacher models, across our core safety tracks (LLM Security, Agentic Safety, Content Safety, Hallucinations, and ML Fairness).

  • Model & system level techniques beyond post-training:Research & deploy new approaches, like Instruction Hierarchy or Risk Detection.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Partner with engineers, data scientists, and research teams across NVIDIA to scale solutions for LLM Security, Agentic Safety, Content Safety, Hallucinations, and ML Fairness.

What we need to see:

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of proven experience in systems software engineering or machine learning engineering.

  • Post-Training Experience:4+ years of hands-on work experience in post-training of LLMs, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RLHF/RLAIF), safety data generation techniques, ablation studies, and deploying models to production.

  • Core Safety Expertise:1+ years of dedicated experience or research inat least oneof the following areas:

    • LLM Security(backdoors, poisoning, latent behaviors).

    • Frontier Risks(deception, manipulation, loss-of-control).

    • Agentic Safety(LLM-level risks for multi-turn tool-calling/agents).

    • Multi-turn Safety Evaluation(dynamic and multi-turn alignment benchmarks).

  • Technical Mastery:In-depth knowledge of machine learning principles and frameworks (PyTorch preferred) with strong Python programming skills.

  • Multimodal Systems:Experience working with large multimodal datasets and multi-modal foundational models.

  • Soft Skills:Outstanding analytical problem-solving abilities paired with excellent collaboration and communication skills.

  • Cultural Alignment:Demonstrates behaviors that build trust: humility, transparency, respect, and intellectual honesty.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Academic Track Record:Published papers on AI Safety, alignment, or machine learning security as a primary author at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, etc.).

  • Community Contributions:Active contributions to open-source AI Safety tools, benchmarks, datasets, and/or models.

  • Advanced Alignment:Proven experience with alignment/fine-tuning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) or any-to-text foundational models.

jobs.description:
As a NOCD Professional, you will help people with OCD learn how to feel better. Members will enroll with our therapy service via our intake team where they’ll be assigned a practitioner.

Practitioners will assist members through the process of:

  • Diagnosis: clinical interview via video session to determine diagnostic impressions and treatment recommendations
  • Therapy: research-backed program that includes live video sessions and app messaging followed by as needed check-ins.

Practitioners will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Practitioners will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions as appropriate.

Our practitioners are supported through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; process groups to support practitioner resilience; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

Apply directly on our website HERE

  • A Independently Licensed Mental Health Professional (LMFT, LCSW, LPCC, LP)
  • Masters degree or higher from an accredited university in the behavioral and mental health field (e.g., social work, counseling, psychology)
  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP and/or ACT is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, receptive to feedback, good with time management
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a competitive, goal-driven, start-up environment
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Administrative and technical support - you focus on the members, NOCD’s team will focus on the rest
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings
  • A fun, supportive, encouraging environment where each other’s successes are celebrated

NOCD is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. Therefore, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. Although OCD affects over 181 million people globally, is ranked by the W.H.O. as a top 10 most disabling condition, and costs 3X more to treat than depression, over 90% of the OCD population isn’t able to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis. As a result, OCD patients often go untreated and suffer in silence, which is why it’s nicknamed "the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Inside NOCD, members can access a licensed mental health professional with specialty training in OCD who can offer online diagnostic interviews, video-based teletherapy sessions, and message-based support. In between each session, members can access moderated support communities and tech-enabled therapeutic tools to ensure they have constant support whenever their provider isn’t around. In an integrated model using our app, researchers at Columbia Medical Center found it to be effective in reducing symptoms of OCD.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world. We’re financially supported by 7wire Ventures, a leading healthcare-focused venture capital firm in the United States. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
